wins.text: Adjusted operating income increased 16% YoY and adjusted operating margin expanded 90 bps at the enterprise level, despite a 2% revenue decline — third consecutive quarter of operating income growth and margin expansion.
Ground adjusted operating income increased $120M with adjusted operating margin expanding 140 bps; ground cost per package was flat YoY despite inflationary environment.
DRIVE delivered $550M in benefits in Q3, with $290M in surface network, $110M in air/international, and $150M in G&A; on track for $1.8B full-year savings.
Completed $1B accelerated share repurchase in Q3, bringing 9-month total to $2B; Board authorized a new $5B share repurchase program on top of $600M remaining under prior authorization.
CapEx guidance reduced to $5.4B for full year, down over $700M from last year and $300M below prior forecast of $5.7B, reflecting reduced capital intensity.

risks.text: Express revenue declined 2% YoY driven by volume softness, lower fuel/demand surcharges, and a mix shift toward lower-yielding deferred and e-commerce products; international export yield pressure of $800M embedded in full-year bridge.
Weakness in global trade continues to constrain international demand, which has 'remained challenged for longer than expected,' requiring ongoing proactive air network realignment.
Express experienced over $200M of inflationary cost pressure on a YoY basis in Q3, partially offset by DRIVE savings and headcount management.
USPS contract (expiring September 29) represents a volume and revenue headwind; service obligations remain fixed despite reduced volumes, creating a structural drag until a new contract is finalized.
European B2B environment remains challenged; FedEx is taking a 'fresh look' at additional opportunities to improve the European business, signaling ongoing underperformance in the region.

guidance_items.detail: Reaffirmed midpoint of adjusted EPS range; narrowed range from $17.00–$18.50 to $17.25–$18.25; now expects to deliver above the midpoint of the original June range despite deteriorating revenue.
Full-year revenue expectations have 'deteriorated significantly over the past 9 months'; continues to assume low single-digit percentage decline for the full year.
Full-year CapEx now expected at $5.4B, down from prior forecast of $5.7B and down over $700M from last year.
Maintaining full-year expectations: modest YoY adjusted margin contraction at Express, adjusted margin improvement at Ground, and strong but lower YoY margin at Freight.
Expect to repurchase additional $500M of common stock in Q4, bringing total FY24 repurchases to $2.5B.
